data.one_liner: Check for and download Shorebird code push updates
data.what_it_does: This package lets a Flutter app query the Shorebird Code Push service for newer patches, read the currently installed patch, and download updates. It supports multiple tracks and provides status callbacks.
use_when: You need explicit control over when updates are checked or downloaded
You want to display update status to users or prompt before installing
You are already using Shorebird but need more granular API access
avoid_when: Your app already uses Shorebird’s automatic background update flow
You only need a simple, one‑time update check without UI integration
strengths: Clear API for checking and downloading patches
No external dependencies beyond ffi and meta
Cross‑platform (android, ios, web, windows, macos, linux)
weaknesses: Requires network calls that can block startup if awaited synchronously
No built‑in UI components for update prompts
